Few steps. Full definitions stay on [Glossary](glossary.qmd); citeable status stays on [Official status](tracker.qmd).

## Orient first

Follow the Orient menu in order:

1. [Course overview](overview.qmd) — week map and what the course covers  
2. [What is LAE?](primer.qmd) — plain-language scope  
3. [How does LAE work?](business-overview.qmd) — value, who pays whom, sectors  
4. [Who decides what?](regulators.qmd) — regulator roles and [standing caveats](regulators.qmd#standing-caveats) (Sandbox ≠ Sandbox X; corridor not operational)  
5. This page — how the rest of the site fits

First-use shortcuts when a term appears: [Sandbox X](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law) (≠ first Regulatory Sandbox); [Cap. 448G](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law); [CASK](glossary.qmd#business-and-economics) (lecture tool, not a data series).

## Then Teach

- [Lectures](lectures.qmd) — slide PDFs and takeaways  
- [Readings](readings.qmd) — documents by week  

## Check what you may cite

- [Official status](tracker.qmd) — [OPEN]{.status-chip .status-open} / [WATCH]{.status-chip .status-watch} / [settled]{.status-chip .status-settled} labels  
- [Timeline](dates.qmd) — dated instruments  
- [Glossary](glossary.qmd) — terms and diagrams  

## Optional later

- [Companies & sectors](landscape.qmd) — market map (company claims ≠ facts)  
- [Government news](news.qmd) · [Business news](industry.qmd) — dated updates  

No Blackboard admin on this companion.
